scripts.title: Windows File Preview Hack: Instant Quick Look Shortcut
scripts.description:
Stop wasting time double-clicking files on Windows. Use this hidden PowerToys Peek shortcut to preview documents instantly.

#WindowsHacks #ProductivityTips #TechHacks #Shorts
scripts.script: Windows users have been opening files completely wrong for years. Stop double-clicking everything when you can preview any document, image, or PDF instantly. Just download Microsoft PowerToys, select your file, and press Control plus Spacebar. It brings the famous Mac Quick Look feature straight to Windows without launching heavy apps. How many unnecessary folders do you click through every single day?

scripts.title: Windows Clipboard History Shortcut You Need

Unlock your hidden Windows clipboard history instantly with this simple keyboard shortcut.
#WindowsHacks #Productivity #TechTips #Shorts
scripts.script: Your PC is hiding a secret clipboard vault. Stop re-copying the same links and text all day. Instead of pressing control V, press Windows key plus V right now. This instantly opens your entire copy history, letting you paste anything from the last week with one click. It works across every single app on Windows. How many items are still hiding in your clipboard right now?

scripts.script: Stop alt-tabbing. Pin any app to your screen instantly. If you constantly switch windows while comparing documents or writing code, you are wasting valuable focus time.
